title: Tip-off
notes: Point a phone or laptop camera at a player and WHISTLE refs them live
Calls traveling (2 steps, or 3 in Beginner, plus pivot-foot rules) and double dribbles, with a whistle and a voice call
Counts dribbles and streaks, and scores shots through a hoop you mark on screen
XP, 10 levels from Rookie to Hall of Fame, 16 badges, and player profiles
Drills: Handles 30 and Ten Shots, with personal bests
